purpose: The interaction data this repo needs to talk to notebooklm-py: which account profile,
which notebooks exist and what each is for, and which harvests are named targets.
workflow.py resolves `--target <name>` here so a caller does not have to retype a
notebook title, and so a target's shape is reviewable in a diff instead of living in
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: the credential. storage_state.json / NOTEBOOKLM_AUTH_JSON
are BEARER credentials -- whoever holds them acts as this Google account -- so this file
carries only a POINTER to where the notebooklm CLI keeps its own, never a copy and never
a value. A registry that materialised the secret to make automation convenient would be
the exact incident check_credential_hygiene.py exists to prevent.
`id` is a PIN, not a lookup shortcut. workflow.py still resolves the title against the
live account and refuses when the two disagree: a stale pin that silently won would
harvest a different notebook under the right name, which is worse than failing.

profile.name: default
profile.verify: notebooklm auth check --test --json  -- require status ok AND checks.token_fetch true; bare --json only proves the cookie file parses
